applications.description: Observation to adjoining Borough - London Borough of Hackney reference: 2026/0685 for the variation of condition 1 (Approved Plans) of the Colville Estate regeneration Outline Planning Permission 2011/0734 (as amended by 2013/4025 and 2021/1406) for 'The demolition of the existing buildings comprising of 412 dwellings and 406 sq.m (Gross Internal Area) of non-residential floorspace, and the development of a residential led mixed use scheme of replacement buildings comprising of: Residential (Use Class C3) up to 884 dwellings, of which up to 1,010 sq.m (GIA) can be Business (Use Class B1); Mixed use of Retail (Use Class A1), Financial and professional services (Use Class A2), Restaurants and café (Use Class A3), Drinking establishments (Use Class A4), Hot food takeaways (Use Class A5), Community/Health uses (Use Class D1), and Assembly and leisure (Use Class D2) up to 950 sq.m (GIA); Vehicular and cycle parking (to basement, semi-basement, under-croft and surface level); Together with associated areas of open space, hard and soft landscaping; alterations to new pedestrian and vehicular accesses and highway and engineering works; electricity sub-station and other utility requirements, including an energy centre; and other associated temporary works or structures.' The amendments would be to the approved parameter plans and include increased maximum building heights at plot G (one metre) and H (80 cm); changes to the estate-wide access and public realm framework; changes to balcony provision zones where projecting balconies are permitted; changes to the defensible frontage to new dwellings; a reduced courtyard to plot G with increased public realm; increased building depths at plots G and H; updated existing tree protection arrangements. [2026/0685]

applications.description:
Non-material minor amendment to planning permission ref: P2020/0941/S73 dated 18/02/2022 (constituting an amendment to planning permission P2018/2269/FUL dated 03/07/2018 (and subsequent amendment P2019/2083/NMA) for: The demolition of the sunken play pitch (site 1), community centre and adjacent caretaker's lodge (site 2) and the construction of a new community centre [282.42 sqm GIA] (site 2) and 46 new dwellings (private and affordable) in four blocks (sites 1 and 2) ranging in height from two to six storeys and associated amenity space, bicycle parking spaces and improvements to the public realm (including to Zoffany Park, site 3). Additionally, stopping up of an area of existing highway to the north and west of Duncombe Road and land immediately west of 158-178 St Johns Way under Section 247 of the Planning Act 1990 to enable redevelopment of Site 1.
The amendments include internal alterations to various units, alterations to risers and rainwater pipes, alterations to fenestration, addition of entrance canopies, increase in size of balcony piers, increase height of parapets to Blocks A & B, reduction of garden to C1, alteration to doors, fenestration, and internal alterations to community centre, removal of bollards at junction of Buxton Road, and widening of pedestrian path south of Zoffany Park. 

The proposed amendment will allow for a change to the wording of the approved description of development to remove reference to private tenure type in relation to the proposed dwellings to be provided.
